world_org_meetings.title: EU member states wrangle over all-important budget: Is a deal this year feasible?
world_org_meetings.description: A marathon EU summit on October 15-16 failed to produce a breakthrough on the European Union's next long-term budget. Although EU leaders put on a brave face at the end of the talks by saying that "the way forward is clearer", EU capitals appear deadlocked on what that path is. At stake is the EU's ability to finance its strategic priorities from 2028 to 2034. The main dividing line is between the so-called "frugal countries", who want deep cuts to the proposed budget, and the "friends of cohesion", who say that cuts are not the answer.

world_org_meetings.title: World set to breach 1.5°C warming limit set by Paris Climate Agreement
world_org_meetings.description: The UN is warning that global commitments to cut planet-heating emissions are falling far short of the Paris climate goals of 1.5 degrees Celsius warming – and put the world on course for 2.6C warming this century. The report by the United Nations Environment Programme lays bare the chasm between rhetoric and action when it comes to tackling global warming, and the challenge before political leaders at November's COP31 climate summit - set to take place next month in Turkey. Story by Emerald Maxwell.

world_org_meetings.title: Search under way for four soldiers missing after gang attack in Haiti
world_org_meetings.description: The UN Security Council holds a meeting on Haiti; the attack on UN-backed forces is expected to dominate the discussions.

world_org_meetings.title: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy speaks at EU summit amid spat with Donald Trump
world_org_meetings.description: EU leaders reaffirmed support for Ukraine at the Brussels summit. But souring relations with the US over Russia and Starlink and a big hole in the budget will make for a difficult winter for Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: Zelensky hails "real leaders" in Europe, blasts Trump's diesel deal with Russia
world_org_meetings.description: Ukrainian ​President Volodymyr Zelensky took aim on Friday at US President Donald Trump's diesel deal with Russia and welcomed the prospect of European allies stepping up their role in talks, calling Moscow's stance a "parody" of peace negotiations. At a European Union summit in Brussels, Zelenskiy said Russia did not want peace. He added that Ukraine was still experiencing disruptions to the SpaceX Starshield satellite system. FRANCE 24's Europe Editor Armen Georgian reports from Brussels.

diplomatic_visits.title: Why the King's Caribbean tour could be 'biggest risk of his reign'
diplomatic_visits.description: The meticulously-planned visit takes in three countries in nine days - but is not without jeopardy.

diplomatic_visits.title: Carney defends doing business with countries that don’t share Canada’s values
diplomatic_visits.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney defended his government’s pursuit of trade with countries accused of human rights abuses, arguing few nations meet Canada’s standards. Wrapping up a visit to Turkey, Carney insisted engagement does not equal approval, but declined to say whether he personally challenged President Erdogan over his government’s crackdown.

diplomatic_visits.title: Malawi opposition demands answers over president's prolonged stay abroad
diplomatic_visits.description: This is President Peter Mutharika's fifth visit to South Africa this year.

diplomatic_visits.title: Macron calls for extreme caution in Gulf, secures critical gas deal in Qatar state visit
diplomatic_visits.description: French president concludes his state visit by reinforcing the strategic partnership with Qatar. He declares his Gulf tour objectives achieved after securing a crucial gas deal with Qatar as he seeks to lower tensions over living costs in France.

diplomatic_visits.title: UK to draft in military aircraft to fight wildfires, Burnham says
diplomatic_visits.description: The prime minister is hosting the UK's first wildfire summit to prepare for future blazes after a record summer 2026.

elections.title: Voters in Brazil head to polls as Lula goes up against Bolsonaro's son
elections.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the son of Brazil's imprisoned ex-president, is challenging Lula, who is seeking a fourth term in office.

elections.title: Who are the candidates in Brazil's presidential election?
elections.description: Voters in Sunday's election are choosing between two very different candidates, as Americas correspondent Ione Wells reports from Rio de Janeiro.

elections.title: Early reports suggest record high turnout in Serbia elections
elections.description: Serbia is heading to the polls as a student movement attempts to oust longtime populist leader Aleksandar Vučić.

elections.title: Netanyahu 'fighting for his political life' in 1st Israeli vote since Oct. 7. He might still survive
elections.description: There are few Israeli analysts willing to write off the country's longest-serving prime minister in Tuesday's election, despite the catastrophic impact of the Hamas-led attacks on Oct. 7, 2023.

elections.title: A polarized Brazil heads to presidential vote Sunday with economy, corruption top of mind
elections.description: Frustrations around corruption and feelings of personal financial stagnation driving voting choices as Brazil heads to presidential run-off on Sunday, Oct. 25.
